documented_capabilities: P4 English MultiNet7 supports configurable phoneme commands without new acoustic-model training.
API permits command add/update, detection threshold, model clean/reset and continuous recognition.
Input contract is16kHz mono PCM16 processed by AFE; existing single producer must remain.
integration_assessment: Not a drop-in replacement: compressed model payload alone is2,160,910bytes, larger than the entire current2MiB filesystem. App embeds its original smaller WakeNet and is near its fixed OTA slot capacity. Actual MultiNet code/linking/workspace costs and keyword/near-word behavior are unmeasured. Requires an explicit capacity solution plus quantitative development probing before considering integration; do not remove dual OTA, change partitioning or silently discard GUI assets.
open_questions: Whether Hey Nyx/Nicks phonemes are accepted with explicit command phonemes.
Whether always-listening or a bounded second-stage verifier can match HiESP FAR, recognition and latency.
Whether model weights and decoder can fit current flash/PSRAM along with GUI and voice.
How a verifier avoids excluding the immediate post-wake request from ordered preroll/FIFO.
